title: Uniform bounds for compact-support reductions
statement: For the fixed input and compactification, every finite compact-support level is constructible and all levels have support in one common integer interval.

source.place: Compact-support paragraph: finite coefficient-change comparisons, before taking the derived limit

proof.text: Finite compact-support constructibility transports through the finite extension-by-zero and proper-image comparisons, giving the stated constructible predicate at every positive level.

Apply the common cohomological interval for the input reductions and the fixed finite-type proper cohomological bound; exact extension by zero does not enlarge the interval, yielding one b₀≤b₁ independent of n.

theorem compactSupport_normalizedReductionTower_bounds
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (hl₀ : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (hK : sfIntegralConstructible l E X K)
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    ∃ b₀ b₁ : ℤ, b₀ ≤ b₁ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
      intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E (n + 1)
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) Y
        ((sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).obj
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)) ∧
      proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
        ((sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).obj
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)) ⊆ Set.Icc b₀ b₁
